fee_parameters.annual_cost_identity: annual_cost_fraction = days_per_year * tau * roundtrip_cost_bps / 1e4  (whole-ticket round trips)
fee_parameters.cohort_identity: gross_exposure_over_equity = holding_days * tau  (H-day cohorts, equal tickets)

fee_parameters.name: x2
fee_parameters.scope: moomoo SG (Moomoo Financial Singapore), US stocks/ETFs, >=1 share orders, eligible-client schedule, SG tax resident

F1.what: eligible-client US stock/ETF schedule: commission $0*, platform $0.99/order, settlement $0.003/sh cap 1%, SEC sells 0.0000206 min $0.01, TAF 0 (note: 0.000195/sh min 0.01 max 9.79 from 2026-02-07), CAT 0.000003/sh, algo +0.05%/side, GST 9% (1.1/1.2/1.4 notes: commission+platform; closing clause: all relevant domestic and foreign fees incl. exchange-related, SG tax residents)

F1b.what: mirror of F1; fee body text identical (diff only in market-widget area)

F2.what: non-eligible schedule (link 'If you are not eligible' on F1): commission $0.0049/sh min $0.99, platform $0.005/sh min $1, each capped at 0.5% of trade value; settlement $0.003/sh; TAF 0.000195 min 0.01 max 9.79

F3.what: TAF paused for transactions 2026-10-01..2026-12-31; resumes 2027-01-01 at $0.000195/sh, max $9.79/trade

F4.what: SEC notice of SR-FINRA-2026-021 (same window, resumption 2027-01-01)

F5.what: Section 31 $20.60/million from 2026-04-04, in effect until 60 days after FY2027 appropriation is enacted

F6.what: index: latest Section 31 advisory is still FY2026 (2026-02-27); FY2027 entry listed is a Section 6(b) filing-fee advisory only

fee_parameters.turnover_definition: one_way_daily_turnover tau = (buy_value + sell_value) / (2 * equity), per trading day
unverified: actual $0-commission eligibility of the future account (T&C page link resolved to a promotions index, not the T&C)
per-invoice rounding of each fee line
actual spread / slippage (no fills observed)
whether GST is charged on pass-through regulatory fees (two notes on F1 disagree; x1 takes the wider reading)
FY2027 Section 31 rate (F5: changes 60 days after FY2027 appropriation; none published as of fetch)
historical TAF/SEC rates before 2026 (fold back-test applies 2026 schedule to all years; assumption, not history)
